options.name: auto_filter
options.description: If set to V(True), the filter option will be set on the header row.

options.name: autosize_columns
options.description: If set to V(True), the columns will be set to fit the longest value.

options.name: bold_header_row
options.description: If set to V(True), the header row will be set to bold.

options.name: data
options.description: The data to put in the Excel file. Note that the columns in the Excel file are created from all the data entries, not just for the first. So data entries can have different keys.

options.name: default_value
options.description: Default value for columns that don't exist in the object.

options.name: freeze_headerrow
options.description: If set to V(True), the header row will be frozen so it stays on the screen when scrolling through the data in Excel.

options.name: path
options.description: The export path. If the file already exists, the worksheet is added to this file. Note that the directory in which the file will be created must exist!

options.name: replace_existing_sheet
options.description: If set to V(False), an error will occur if the Excel file already contains a sheet with the name in O(worksheetname). If set to V(True), an existing sheet with the name in O(worksheetname) will be overwritten.

options.name: worksheetname
options.description: The worksheet name. If the sheet name already exists, an error will occur, unless O(replace_existing_sheet) is set to V(True) (the default value).
